ideas.pitch: An agentic multi-agent system that optimizes municipal garbage collection trucks in real-time based on smart bin fill levels and traffic patterns, targeting sustainable city operations.
ideas.title: EcoRoute Mysore: Autonomous Waste Fleet Routing via Agentic Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the hackathon's core focus on Agentic Intelligence and Sustainable Development by showcasing a concrete operational cost and emission reduction metric for judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered agricultural monitoring dashboard that uses satellite imagery and local sensor inputs to deploy autonomous irrigation alerts, promoting sustainable water usage for local farming.
ideas.title: AgriSense: Autonomous Crop Stress & Water Runoff Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines satellite data analysis and agricultural sustainability, fitting the strict environmental development focus expected by VVCE professors.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent reinforcement learning simulation that dynamically reroutes solar and battery power across campus buildings to maximize renewable energy self-consumption during peak hours.
ideas.title: GridGuardian: Autonomous Microgrid Energy Distributor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies autonomous multi-agent systems to an energy sustainability problem, directly aligning with the dual theme of agentic tech and sustainability.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning pipeline that analyzes water body sensor inputs and weather data to forecast algal blooms and pollution spikes 72 hours in advance for local water bodies.
ideas.title: AquaGuard Mysore: AI Lake Eutrophication Early Warning System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven winning formula of predictive environmental monitoring with a hyper-local application that local judges can immediately appreciate.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous LLM-powered agent that crawls campus utility bills, transport logs, and waste reports to generate actionable carbon offset recommendations and a live university ESG scoreboard.
ideas.title: CampusCarbon: Autonomous ESG Audit Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an instantly demoable dashboard tracking tangible sustainability KPIs, making it highly attractive for academic institution hackathon judges.
